definitions.gloss: paddy rice; rice grown in flooded fields
definitions.explanation: Rice cultivated in flooded paddy fields, as opposed to rice grown in dry fields. The standard method of rice farming in Japan.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{水稲|すいとう}が{主|しゅ}だ。
examples.english: In Japan, paddy rice is the main type.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{水稲|すいとう}の{栽培|さいばい}が{盛|さか}んだ。
examples.english: Paddy rice cultivation is thriving in this region.

examples.japanese: {水稲|すいとう}は{田|た}に{水|みず}を{張|は}って{育|そだ}てるため、{水|みず}の{管理|かんり}がとても{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
examples.english: Because paddy rice is grown with water flooded into the fields, managing the water is very important.

notes:
An agricultural term contrasting with {陸稲|りくとう} (upland/dry-field rice). Almost all rice in Japan is {水稲|すいとう}, grown in flooded paddies.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {陸稲|りくとう}: upland rice — grown in ordinary dry fields without flooding
- {稲|いね}: rice plant — the plant itself, regardless of growing method
- {田|た}・{水田|すいでん}: rice paddy — the flooded field where {水稲|すいとう} is grown
